name: watched-source-github
description: Fires your automations when a GitHub repo you watch ships a release or opens an issue. A newly watched repository starts from what exists now, so its history never floods in, and every request goes through your network egress settings.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Repositories
x-meta.help: Comma-separated owner/name list, e.g. "acme/widgets, acme/gadgets". An entry that is not owner/name is skipped.

x-meta.label: GitHub Token
x-meta.help: A GitHub personal access token. Required for private repositories and to raise the anonymous rate limit. Leave it empty to watch public repositories anonymously.

x-meta.label: GitHub API Base
x-meta.help: Override for GitHub Enterprise. Defaults to the public API. A server on your own network is reachable only once its host is allowed under Settings → Security → Network egress.

x-meta.label: Request Timeout
x-meta.help: Maximum seconds to wait for a GitHub API response.
